asset_discovery_result.S33_PW07_reason: PW07 requires an exact common cocycle, semilinear descent, intended Jacobian and literal representative/divisor/Cartier data. No such BT-bound common cocycle/divisor package is retained in the current Stage36 source set.

five_root_kummer_monomial_group.squareclass_restriction: On every receiver Q_v-lift, [g_i(y_v)]=[c_i] in Q_v^*/Q_v^{*2}; inverse equals itself in the exponent-2 squareclass group.
five_root_kummer_monomial_group.monomial_definition: m_{a,e}(y)=a*prod_i g_i(y)^{e_i}, with a in Q^* and e in F2^5
five_root_kummer_monomial_group.monomial_restriction: [m_{a,e}(y_v)]=[a*prod_i c_i^{e_i}]_v, the localization of one fixed global Q-squareclass independent of the receiver local point.

quaternion_family_no_go.family: Quaternion symbols (m_{a,e}(y),m_{b,f}(y)) whose two entries lie in the multiplicative subgroup generated by Q^* and g0,...,g4; finite sums/products of such 2-torsion symbols are included at the evaluation level.
quaternion_family_no_go.validity_scope: CU does not assert that every displayed symbol extends unramified to the relevant compactification. The conclusion applies to any actual Brauer/secondary representative from this family whenever its local evaluation on the retained receiver open is defined.
quaternion_family_no_go.receiver_local_reduction: (m_{a,e}(y_v),m_{b,f}(y_v))_v=(A_e,B_f)_v for fixed global A_e=a*prod_i c_i^{e_i}, B_f=b*prod_i c_i^{f_i}.
quaternion_family_no_go.adelic_total_for_each_symbol: product_v (A_e,B_f)_v=+1 by Hilbert reciprocity for the two fixed global squareclasses.
quaternion_family_no_go.adelic_total_for_finite_sum: zero additive invariant, equivalently multiplicative total +1, because each quaternion summand is separately reciprocity-trivial.

structural_diagnosis.new_boundary: Passing from the five-root Kummer class to quaternion symbols built only from the same five root functions does not restore point dependence on the receiver lift locus; every such entry collapses to a fixed global squareclass.
structural_diagnosis.what_is_not_ruled_out: A genuinely non-Kummer divisor/Cech class, a secondary extension/cocycle not generated by these five root functions, or another Brauer representative whose restriction retains receiver-point dependence.

route_result.next_leaf_semantics: Seek a source-bound Brauer/secondary class outside the Q^* plus five-root-function monomial subgroup. Require literal divisor/Cech/common-cocycle data or a source-bound secondary extension, then verify that its evaluation remains point-dependent on actual receiver lifts before any local-global credit.
